description: This file provides support for the GPT model family in the litellm project, including configuration, request/response transformations, environment validation, and streaming handling for OpenAI's chat API.

classes.name: OpenAIGPTConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI GPT models, supporting various parameters like temperature, max tokens, functions, and CDN configurations, with methods for mapping parameters and transforming content items.

classes.name: OpenAIChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming responses from the OpenAI chat completion API, parsing chunks of data into ModelResponseStream objects.
